statement: All data is synthetic and generated by generate.py from a fixed seed. No external, public or personal data was ingested; names are random combinations of common first/last names and e-mail addresses use the reserved example.test domain.
schema_inspiration: Generic OKR / 360-feedback / performance-review domain concepts (no dataset or license-bound material copied).
licence: Generated output is free of third-party licence obligations; provided for evaluation use.
